async def act(page):
    # Navigate to the admin login page
    await page.goto('/index.php/admin')
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Log in with default admin credentials
    await page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Username').fill('admin')
    await page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Password').fill('admin123')
    await page.get_by_role('button', name='Sign in').click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Navigate to the Orders page
    await page.goto('/index.php/admin/sales/order/')
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Filter for fraud suspect orders
    await page.get_by_role('combobox', name='Status').select_option('Fraud Suspect')
    await page.get_by_role('button', name='Search').click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Sort by date to get the earliest order
    await page.get_by_role('columnheader', name='Date').click()
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    # Get the customer name from the first row
    first_row = page.get_by_role('row').nth(1)
    customer_cell = first_row.get_by_role('cell').nth(0)
    customer_name = await customer_cell.text_content()
    return customer_name
